visual_goal: Show the hourglass: many lines of business above and many money-movement partners below meet at one narrow generic payments waist.
prompt: A vertical hourglass shape drawn as a clean outline, centered. In the wide top bowl sit four small rounded boxes side by side: 'Rides', 'Eats', 'Freight' and 'New business'. A single downward arrow runs from each of these four boxes into the narrow neck. The narrow neck holds one stacked column of three slim boxes, top to bottom: 'Configuration', 'Payments API', 'Orders and entries'. Beside the neck, a short label 'Payments platform'. In the wide bottom bowl sit three boxes side by side: 'Providers' with a small cloud icon, 'Banks' with a small bank-building icon, and 'Cash and wallets' with a small coin icon. A single downward arrow runs from the neck into each of these three boxes. Exactly seven arrows in total.
alt: An hourglass with four lines of business at the top, a narrow payments platform waist of configuration, API and orders in the middle, and providers, banks and cash flows at the bottom.

visual_goal: Show tiered retries, a dead letter queue with an owner, and a validator that compares expected side effects with what happened, with repair by a new order.
prompt: A left-to-right flow along one horizontal main line. At the far left a pipe labeled 'Order topic', one arrow right into a box 'Consumer'. One green arrow from the right side of 'Consumer' straight right into a second pipe labeled 'Next stage'. One arrow from the right end of 'Next stage' straight right into a tall box 'Validator' with a balance-scale icon. One arrow from 'Validator' right into a fresh document with a plus sign labeled 'New order'. Above the main line, a filing box 'Expected effects': one blue arrow from the top of 'Consumer' up into it, and one blue arrow from it down-right into 'Validator'. Below the main line, under 'Consumer': one orange arrow down from 'Consumer' into a small box 'Retry, short delay', one arrow down into a box 'Retry, longer delay', one arrow down into a red bin labeled 'Dead letters' with a small unlabeled person figure standing beside it as its owner. Exactly nine arrows.
alt: Messages flow from an order topic through a consumer to the next stage, with failures dropping through short and longer retry tiers into an owned dead letter bin, and a validator comparing expected effects with outcomes and repairing by a new order.

visual_goal: Contrast the wrong path (timeout treated as failure, new key to a second PSP, rider charged twice) with the right path (request stored first, retry to the same PSP with the same key).
prompt: Two side-by-side panels separated by a thin vertical line. Left panel headed 'Wrong path' with a small red cross. In it: a box 'Platform' at the left; to its right, two stacked provider boxes 'PSP A' on top and 'PSP B' below. An arrow from 'Platform' to 'PSP A' carries a small key tag 'K1'; a dashed line with an hourglass returns from 'PSP A' to 'Platform', labeled 'Timeout'. A second arrow from 'Platform' to 'PSP B' carries a different key tag 'K2'. Below, a worried unlabeled rider figure with two coins leaving a wallet, labeled 'Charged twice'. Right panel headed 'Right path' with a small green check. In it: a filing cabinet 'Request store' at the far left, then a box 'Platform', then a provider box 'PSP A' at the right. One arrow from 'Platform' left into 'Request store'. An arrow from 'Platform' to 'PSP A' carries key tag 'K1'; a dashed line with an hourglass returns from 'PSP A' to 'Platform', labeled 'Timeout'. A second curved arrow from 'Platform' to the same 'PSP A' carries the same key tag 'K1'. A green arrow from 'PSP A' back into 'Platform' carries a single coin and a check mark, labeled 'Charged once'.
alt: Two panels: on the wrong path a timeout from PSP A leads to a new charge at PSP B with key K2 and the rider is charged twice; on the right path the request is stored first and retried at PSP A with the same key K1, charging once.

visual_goal: Show Uber's documented components for money movement and accounting, with solid arrows for stated relationships and dashed arrows for the two links the author inferred.
prompt: A left-to-right architecture illustration on a light background. Top row, left to right: a box 'Lines of business', an arrow into a large central box 'Gulfstream', an arrow from 'Gulfstream' right into a group of small plain buildings labeled 'PSPs and banks'. Directly below 'Gulfstream', an open book 'LedgerStore' with a solid arrow down from 'Gulfstream'. Bottom row, left to right: a box 'Rule repository' with an arrow right into a large box 'Finance Computation Platform', which has three solid arrows leaving it: one right into a funnel 'Aggregation', one down into a box 'Audit framework', and one right into a box 'Reconciliation'. A solid arrow also goes from 'PSPs and banks' down into 'Reconciliation'. Two arrows are drawn dashed and orange: one from 'Gulfstream' diagonally down into 'Finance Computation Platform', and one from 'Aggregation' right into an open book at the far right labeled 'General ledger'. All other arrows are solid dark blue. Exactly ten arrows.
alt: Uber's components: lines of business feed Gulfstream, which writes to LedgerStore and moves money through PSPs and banks; the Finance Computation Platform applies a rule repository and feeds aggregation, an audit framework and reconciliation, with dashed links to the platform and to the general ledger marking the author's interpretation.

visual_goal: Show which links are documented (solid) and which links every enterprise must still design to the general ledger (dashed), where the public material stops.
prompt: A left-to-right illustration split by a soft vertical boundary: the left two thirds on a light solid background, the right third on a faint misty background. Left side: at the far left, a box 'Reconciliation'. Next, a vertical column of three items stacked top to bottom: box 'Accounting platform' on top, box 'Payments ledger' in the middle, and a group of plain buildings 'Providers and banks' at the bottom. Four solid dark blue arrows on the left side: from 'Payments ledger' straight up into 'Accounting platform'; from 'Payments ledger' straight down into 'Providers and banks'; from 'Accounting platform' left into 'Reconciliation'; from 'Providers and banks' left into 'Reconciliation'. Misty right third: a tall open book 'General ledger' spanning the height of the column, and to its right a box 'Period close'. Three parallel horizontal dashed orange arrows cross the boundary, one from the right side of each item in the column straight right into 'General ledger'. One dashed orange arrow from 'General ledger' right into 'Period close'. Exactly eight arrows.
alt: Documented solid links among the payments ledger, accounting platform, providers and reconciliation, and dashed links into the general ledger and period close in a misty zone where the public evidence stops.
